## 2. Technology Stack & Engineering Standards

### Frontend Engineering
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router, Server Components, SSG, ISR, Turbopack)
- **UI Architecture**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Framer Motion
- **Performance Targets**: Lighthouse Scores > 95/100, LCP < 1.2s, CLS = 0, FID/INP < 50ms

### Backend & Cloud Infrastructure
- **Serverless & Edge Compute**: Next.js Edge Runtime, Vercel Functions, AWS Lambda
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, ClickHouse (Columnar Analytics), Redis (Caching)
- **Vector Search & AI RAG**: Qdrant, Pinecone, Pgvector, OpenAI Embeddings (`text-embedding-3-small`)
- **LLM APIs**: OpenAI GPT-4o/GPT-4o-mini, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Custom Function Calling Routers

### Code Quality & Security Standards
- **IP Ownership**: 100% full intellectual property transfer to clients upon milestone settlement
- **Security Audits**: SSL/TLS 1.3 encryption, SOC2/HIPAA compliance guidelines, WCAG 2.1 AAA accessibility standards
- **Zero Lock-in**: Clean, modular, fully documented source code with strict ESLint / TypeScript rules

## 3. Service Matrices & Deliverables

### A. Business Website Development
- **URL**: https://geetanjalisoftwares.com/services/business-website
- **Scopes**:
  1. *Local Presence & Local SEO*: Google Business Profile sync, neighborhood schema markup, review widgets.
  2. *India-Wide Scale*: UPI gateway integrations (Razorpay, Paytm), multi-city edge caches, regional language UI.
  3. *Global Enterprise Architecture*: Global CDN edge distribution, hreflang tag setups, multi-currency calculators.

### B. Web Application Development
- **URL**: https://geetanjalisoftwares.com/services/web-applications
- **Deliverables**: Multi-role user authentication, real-time WebSocket telemetry, serverless API routers, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.

### C. AI Chatbots & Autonomous Automation
- **URL**: https://geetanjalisoftwares.com/services/ai-chatbot
- **Deliverables**: Semantic documentation RAG indexing, scoped REST API function execution, human agent escalation handoffs, 24/7 ticket deflection.

### D. Custom CRM Software
- **URL**: https://geetanjalisoftwares.com/services/crm-custom-software
- **Deliverables**: Multi-stage lead scoring, custom WhatsApp/Email webhooks, director analytics dashboards, zero per-seat subscription overheads.

### E. Headless E-Commerce
- **URL**: https://geetanjalisoftwares.com/services/ecommerce
- **Deliverables**: Sub-second page navigations, Shopify Storefront API GraphQL integrations, customized checkout steps, dynamic product schema.

### F. Corporate Branding & Visual Identity
- **URL**: https://geetanjalisoftwares.com/services/branding
- **Deliverables**: Figma design token libraries, vector logo variants (SVG/PNG), brand guidelines PDF, typography pairings, color specifications.

## 4. Case Studies & Technical Impact

### 1. Vesper CRM (`/case-studies/vesper-crm`)
- **Client**: Vesper Properties Group (Commercial Real Estate)
- **Impact Metrics**: -85% Lead Response Time, 320+ Active Agents, +42% Deals Closed / Quarter
- **Tech**: Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, WhatsApp Webhooks

### 2. Aether AI (`/case-studies/aether-ai`)
- **Client**: Aether Tech Global (SaaS Platform)
- **Impact Metrics**: 68% Support Deflection Rate, 12-second Average Resolution Time, 4.9/5 CSAT
- **Tech**: OpenAI API, Qdrant Vector Search, FastAPI, Python

### 3. Apex Commerce (`/case-studies/apex-commerce`)
- **Client**: Apex Retail International (D2C Brand)
- **Impact Metrics**: 99/100 Lighthouse Performance, +210% Organic Search Traffic, +3.4% Mobile Conversion Rate
- **Tech**: Next.js App Router, Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Tailwind CSS
